author: reek
body: The receiver-side companion to chan-lost-wakeup. A consumer blocks on an empty capacity-one channel; a producer sends one value, and the wake path hands it across. Both finish and proc 0 -- which waits on both -- prints "rdone".

author: reek
body: On a correct compiler this prints "rdone" cooperatively: nothing runs between the consumer's emptiness check and its commit to BLOCKED, so the wake is never lost. The recv-block lost-wakeup lives in a ~15-instruction window that no timer reliably hits; this test is driven to a deterministic hang by a throwaway compiler built with the recv-block yield mutant, patched to yield inside that window and never shipped.
